dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Thin, pale-gray edges provide a sharp, linear boundary against the dark gray feather bodies on the folded wings.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: The transition is indistinct, appearing as a continuous, monochromatic gray surface with no visible demarcation line.

other_distinctive_markers: The tail exhibits high-contrast, wide, alternating black and pale gray transverse bands; a prominent rufous-colored patch is visible on the lateral side of the head.
